subject: Post-call: procurement timeline & next steps (AcmeCloud)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement timeline & next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi Sofia

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

What we covered:
- Platform fit: Redwood will be used for internal customer-facing features (low-latency generation, embeddings).
- Data & security: AcmeCloud will host only non-PII prompt data; security review required.
- Commercial: target FYQ2 start; procurement route TBD (PO vs card).

Action items / asks for AcmeCloud:
1) Please confirm preferred payment method: PO (preferred by finance) or corporate card.
2) Are you interested in procuring via AWS Marketplace (we can list & provide SaaS contract) or direct PO?
3) Please share the procurement contact and any preferred PO template (I attached our PO template for reference).

Attached: mutual-action-plan-ACME-2487.xlsx (draft) and redwood-PO-template.pdf

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Legal review (MSA/partner terms): 5–7 business days after initial redline
- Security questionnaire & evidence review: ~10 business days
- Finance/PO issuance: 3–5 business days after approvals

If that aligns, I'll update the MAP with milestone dates and loop in our legal and security leads. Would you be able to confirm procurement route and contact by EOD Friday?

Thanks looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-ACME-2487.xlsx, redwood-PO-template.pdf

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement timeline & next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the clear recap. This looks good. A few quick answers: 
- Procurement route: looks like this will go through PO (finance prefers this). We rarely use corporate cards for this spend.
- Marketplace: we're interested in AWS Marketplace for ease of procurement, but we need to understand timing and whether your offer will be available there by the start date.
- Procurement contact: procurement@acmecloud.com (cc'd on this reply) Miguel Torres will be our procurement lead.

I'll ask Finance to prioritize once Legal and Security give greenlights. Can you update the MAP with proposed milestone dates and share a final version?

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Product Operations | AcmeCloud
sofia@acmecloud.com

Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: procurement timeline & next steps (AcmeCloud)

Looping you both in Acme confirmed PO path and procurement contact (procurement@acmecloud.com). They are also open to AWS Marketplace but need timing clarity.

Marcus can you confirm expected turnaround for standard MSA redlines? We should have an answer to Sofia by EOD so Finance can plan.
Camila can you flag the security checklist effort and whether we need any extra evidence or SOC extracts for their reviewers?

I've attached the MAP and our PO template they asked to review. I'll update the MAP after I get your estimates and Sofia's confirmation on marketplace timing.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: procurement timeline & next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi team

We can target 5 business days for standard MSA review and redlines assuming they use our standard contract and only request typical commercial edits. If they send a custom SOW or material legal changes, add another 3–5 business days. 

Notes for the MAP:
- Legal review start: when Acme returns the first redline (or confirms using our standard MSA).
- Deliverable: redlined MSA + summary of key commercial points for execs.

Please ask Acme to send any redlines directly to legal@redwood.ai to keep routing fast.

-Marcus
General Counsel | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: procurement timeline & next steps (AcmeCloud)

Thanks quick security note:
- Our security reviews typically take ~10 business days for questionnaire review + evidence collection (SOC 2 report, architecture diagram, data handling summary).
- If Acme has a security questionnaire, please forward it to security@redwood.ai (I attached a short security-questionnaire.pdf stub they can use).
- Key open items we'll need to confirm: data retention policy, access controls for logs, and whether there will be any customer PII in prompts.

I'll block time on our side to prioritize this once they confirm the PO route.

-Camila Reyes
Product Security Lead | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement timeline & next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi all

Thanks for the quick coordination. This is looking good on our side. A few confirmations so we can align internally: 
- Procurement confirms PO route, target issuance week of 2026-03-23 pending Legal & Security sign-off. Our internal expectation (contingent on standard redlines & security evidence) is PO issued by 2026-03-26.
- Marketplace: we'd prefer AWS Marketplace if Redwood can be listed by start date, can you confirm if that's feasible or whether we should plan direct PO?
- I'll share any procurement-specific PO terms if they differ from your template.

Please update the MAP with these milestone dates and circulate a final so Finance has clear expectations. I've cc'd Miguel (procurement) who will coordinate on PO issuance.

Best,
Sofia
